unsupported: Unsupported storage: the app declares durable local state (database_path = /database (nix/pkgs/complement/config.toml)) with no VOLUME or Compose mount. Deployz provides object storage, not an attached data directory.

Final review: Tuwunel stores all homeserver data in an embedded RocksDB database on local disk, and it has no PostgreSQL or MySQL option, so Deployz's stateless containers cannot hold the product's core data.
